dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-valued functional on the quotient, obtained by converting the quotient-lifted ENNReal gauge to a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the functional asserted to satisfy the five norm axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The quotient of measurable real-valued functions having finite gauge by the submodule of functions equal to zero almost everywhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the vector space on which the asserted norm-like functional is defined.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies zero and addition in the target statements.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real module structure inherited by the quotient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real scalar multiplication in the homogeneity statement.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The submodule of measurable real-valued functions whose ENNReal gauge is strictly below infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts quotient representatives to measurable finite-gauge functions and ensures their gauge can be represented as a finite real value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The submodule of finite-gauge functions that vanish almost everywhere with respect to μ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007

binders: An arbitrary type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
An instance asserting that μ is a probability measure.
Elements x and y of the quotient vector space LocalDef002 μ where required.
A real scalar c where required.
hypotheses: Each quotient element is represented by a measurable real-valued function with finite underlying ENNReal gauge, modulo equality almost everywhere; this restriction is built into LocalDef002 rather than stated as a separate hypothesis.
conclusions: For every x, LocalDef001 μ x is nonnegative.
For every x, LocalDef001 μ x = 0 if and only if x = 0 in the quotient.
For every x and y, LocalDef001 μ (x + y) ≤ LocalDef001 μ x + LocalDef001 μ y.
For every real c and every x, LocalDef001 μ (c • x) = |c| · LocalDef001 μ x.
mathematical_definitions: For a measurable real-valued function X, an ENNReal scale t is admissible when t is nonzero and finite, exp(X(ω)^2/(t.toReal)^2) is integrable, and its μ-integral is at most 2.
The underlying ENNReal gauge of X is the infimum of all admissible scales.
The finite-gauge space consists of measurable functions whose underlying gauge is strictly below infinity.
The null subspace consists of finite-gauge functions equal to zero μ-almost everywhere.
LocalDef002 μ is the quotient of the finite-gauge space by the null subspace.
The underlying gauge descends to quotient classes because it is invariant under the quotient relation.
LocalDef001 is the real conversion of this descended ENNReal gauge.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every probability measure μ, the real-valued infimum gauge induced on equivalence classes of measurable finite-gauge real random variables modulo almost-everywhere equality is a norm: it is nonnegative, vanishes at zero and only at zero, satisfies the triangle inequality, and is absolutely homogeneous under real scalar multiplication.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The asserted norm is defined only on the quotient of measurable functions having finite underlying ENNReal gauge, not on all functions Ω → Real.
Equality x = 0 is equality in the quotient, hence corresponds to the representative being zero μ-almost everywhere rather than pointwise everywhere.
The scale predicate excludes both t = 0 and t = ∞ and separately requires integrability of the exponential integrand.

The target assumes a probability-measure instance. For measurable spaces admitting no such measure, that universally quantified instance-dependent case has no inhabitant and contributes no substantive assertion.
LocalDef001 uses ENNReal.toReal, whose behavior at infinity could otherwise collapse information; the finite-gauge restriction is intended to prevent quotient elements from having infinite gauge.
Because the gauge is an infimum, zero-definiteness is a substantive conclusion: admissible positive scales may approach zero even though zero itself is excluded.
The integral threshold is fixed at 2, so the functional's normalization depends on that constant.
ambiguities: The reviewed description of D008 names its admissibility predicate as LocalDef002, while the inventory separately identifies the detailed admissibility predicate as D016 and LocalDef002 is also the quotient-space definition. The coherent mathematical reading is that D008 takes the infimum of scales satisfying D016; the local-name reference in the reviewed sentence is therefore ambiguous.
The exact library convention of ENNReal.toReal at infinity is not expanded in the dossier, although it does not affect the intended finite-gauge domain.

No explicit formula for the proof obligations establishing closure, representative invariance, or the five conclusions is included; the translation records only the proposition and supplied semantic definitions.
